messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: env=canary, service=web-frontend, ref=refs/tags/v1.4.2, commit=7a3f9c2 (initiated by alice) :rocket:
alice: rolling out canary 10% -> 50% at 12:02 UTC. change window ends 12:30 UTC. release notes: minor perf tweaks, new caching layer.
dmitri: watching 5xx dashboards — seeing a small spike on canary instances, ~0.6% -> 1.8% over 3 minutes. tagging for triage. :eyes:
oncall-bot: Incident alert: 5xx-rate > 1% threshold for service web-frontend.canary (metric=proxy.5xx_rate, value=1.8%)
kate: can anyone confirm client-facing errors? I see timeouts in the logs: `upstream read timed out` on canary pods.
sam: looks like KV-cache misses increased after rolling new image. suspecting a cache invalidation bug in 7a3f9c2.
dmitri: recommend rollback for canary to avoid promoting to prod. propose pin to v1.4.1 for the rest of the fleet.
alice: agreed, initiating rollback. rollback reason: elevated 5xx + increased latency, regressions in prefix cache behavior.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: env=canary, service=web-frontend, from=refs/tags/v1.4.2, to=refs/tags/v1.4.1, rollback_commit=3b2e4a8 (started by alice) :warning:
dmitri: command I ran locally to pin the ReplicaSet: `kubectl set image deploy/web-frontend web-frontend=redwood/web-frontend:v1.4.1 --namespace=canary` — will push the same via CI.
alice: CI job queued: `ci/deployments/redeploy-canary` with tag v1.4.1. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/9876
oncall-bot: Deploy verdict: canary rollback in progress, expected completion ~12:12 UTC. Monitoring will auto-check error rates for 10m post-deploy.
sam: FYI: added a temp feature-flag to disable the new cache path in staging to replicate the issue.
kate: after rollback completes, let's hold on promoting to prod. we need a follow-up patch to revert the cache-change or add fallback.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: env=canary, service=web-frontend, deployed_ref=refs/tags/v1.4.1, commit=3b2e4a8, duration=5m 18s, status=success :white_check_mark:
alice: rollback verified, 5xx down to baseline 0.2% within 4 minutes. tagging release notes update: reverted cache change.
dmitri: creating a revert branch/PR: `git revert --no-commit 7a3f9c2 && git commit -m "revert: cache invalidation causing canary regressions"` targeting release/v1.4.x.
alice: creating changelog entry and incident blameless doc. we should schedule a canary re-deploy after the revert PR merges and we test in staging.
oncall-bot: Post-rollback checks completed: latency and error-rate back within SLOs. closing alert.
deploy-bot: Redeploy started (pin/redeploy): env=canary, service=web-frontend, ref=refs/tags/v1.4.1, initiated_by=alice. Note: no promotion to prod will happen automatically.
sam: added `@eng-oncall` to the thread for awareness.
kate: thanks. when the revert PR is ready, please add the postmortem checklist and test vectors.
alice: logging notes: `kubectl rollout status deploy/web-frontend -n canary` and `curl -sv https://canary.web.redwood.ai/healthz` passed.
dmitri: after we merge revert, let's run the full canary with the new image but only 10% traffic for 20m, not 50%.
alice: acknowledged. closing thread after release doc update. :lock:
